title: Efficiently Utilizing DataStorage
author: MapleStory Worlds Creator Center
summary: This official creator guide explains practical patterns for reducing DataStorage requests, batching operations, and staying within storage and credit limits.

sections.title: Efficient access
items: Plan data scope and access frequency before implementing storage calls.
Batch compatible operations and avoid repeated reads or writes that can be cached.
Measure usage in a released test World.

notes: Structured summary verified against the official Creator Center lesson on 2026-07-27.
steps: Map stored data to the narrowest suitable scope.
Avoid redundant requests and cache safe reads.
Measure and revise the design against actual credit usage.
